organization.name_ja: 全国土木建築国民健康保険組合
organization.name_en: National Civil Engineering and Construction National Health Insurance Association

affected.note: Insured members and dependents of one member company. The disc was password protected, was retrieved and the data deleted.

summary.en: The National Civil Engineering and Construction NHI Association sent an optical disc with insurance card data of 17,477 insured people of one member company to an unrelated business, after a staff member mixed up company codes. The recipient reported it on 2024-03-01 and the disc was retrieved.
summary.ja: 全国土木建築国民健康保険組合は、職員が事業所記号を取り違え、加入事業所1社の被保険者17,477人分の被保険者証データを保存した光ディスクを無関係の事業者へ送付した。2024年3月1日に受領者からの連絡で判明し、回収した。

sources.title: 組合加入事業所の個人情報を他社へ誤提供 - 土健保
